summary: Production-ready product implementation plan for FlexiFit: transition from class prototype to a full, real, end-to-end usable hybrid fitness and nutrition platform for Uganda. Includes real database persistence, production auth, real MediaPipe pose analytics, Gemini 3.8 Flash vision form analysis, comprehensive FAO/Uganda local food composition database, free Open Food Facts API integration, real WhatsApp/Meet scheduling, real mobile money payment architecture, and client compliance triage engine.
